title: Use Seedance 2.5 to generate stable, cinematic shots up to 30 seconds long for…
content:
Use Seedance 2.5 to generate stable, cinematic shots up to 30 seconds long for longer-form storytelling.  
Use 50+ multimodal reference inputs to maintain character/product consistency across multiple shots.  
Use timestamp-based prompts to adjust specific moments in the clip without re-generating the entire video.  
Use Seedance 2.5 precision controls to direct camera movement, scene composition, and character placement.
